title: Copilot App — Session Startup Health
description: Session creation and resume reliability for the Copilot App desktop client.

panels.title: Sessions started over time
panels.query: metric=session_start | where version = $app_version | count by day

panels.title: Sessions started by operation
panels.query: metric=session_start | where version = $app_version | count by operation

panels.title: Startup errors by reason
panels.query: metric=startup_error | where version = $app_version | count by reason
